_note: Camera mount parameters relative to robot frame.
Robot frame: x forward, y left, z up.
Camera frame (OpenCV): x right, y down, z forward (optical axis).
Measure these values from the robot center of rotation to the camera lens center.
Positive camera_x_r_m = camera is in front of robot center.
Positive camera_y_r_m = camera is to the left of robot center.
Positive camera_z_r_m = camera is above ground.
pitch_deg = degrees the camera tilts DOWN from horizontal (0 = flat, 45 = 45deg down, 90 = straight down).
yaw_deg = small heading trim if camera is not exactly facing forward (positive = rotated left).
_calibration_note: To calibrate extrinsics: place an ArUco marker at a known position
relative to the robot (e.g., directly in front at X=0.3m, Y=0),
run aruco_robot_pose.py, and compare the reported x,y to the tape-measured values.
Adjust camera_x_r_m, camera_z_r_m, and pitch_deg to minimize error.
Do this after intrinsic calibration is complete.
